title: approvals.json: the user's recorded approvals for one run
description: One file per run at <data>/runs/<module_id>/approvals.json. Each record holds the user's reply verbatim. A single-attempt approval lets the fill write one single-attempt item (never submit it). A waiver lets one waivable validator rail pass for the items it names. Written only by ltcore.approvals (emit_fill.py approve); a record is never edited after it is written.

approval_id.description: A- plus the first eight hexadecimal SHA256 digits of canonical JSON containing module_id and record. Record contains every recorded field except approval_id; JSON keys are sorted with compact separators and UTF-8 encoding. Editing the kind, rail, items, capture digest or reply invalidates the ID.

question_digest.description: Question digest of the capture the user approved. A changed question requires a new approval.

item_id.description: The approved item. Required for a single-attempt approval.

rail.description: The rail a waiver lets pass. Required for a waiver.

item_ids.description: Items a per-item waiver covers. Absent: the waiver covers the items the fill report names.

quote.description: The user's reply, verbatim. The agent asks first and never reconstructs the words.
